summary: Retest of three fixes on top of iteration_5. All three fixes VERIFIED: (1) preview-bill accepts table_payer_id and per-player rows update correctly (backend param + frontend refresh); (2) Close & New Frame no longer triggers 'Credit requires a linked player' for unlinked sessions thanks to pay_full=True server top-up; (3) InvoiceModal shows no span-in-option warnings (0 seen) and no missing-DialogTitle warning. Backend pytest: 4/4 pass. Frontend flow verified in browser.

integration_issues.flow: Generate Bill (non-'Fill Full/New Frame' path) on unlinked multi-player session
integration_issues.issue: The regular 'Generate Bill' button still uses pay_full=false. If cashier clicks 'Fill Full' then 'Generate Bill', tiny rounding drift between click and submit can produce credit > 0 on an unlinked session, triggering 400 'Credit requires a linked player'. Reproduced during cleanup step. Not in scope of the three fixes (Close & New Frame path is fixed).

issues: Radix warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' still appears (not the DialogTitle warning that was fixed). Non-blocking; a11y improvement suggestion — add DialogDescription (can be VisuallyHidden).

action_items: Optional: apply the same pay_full=true auto-top-up trick to the regular 'Generate Bill' button (or offer 'Fill Full' as pay_full) so unlinked multi-player sessions never hit rounding-drift 400s.
Optional a11y: add VisuallyHidden DialogDescription to CloseTableModal / OpenTableModal to silence remaining Radix warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py preview_bill now correctly forwards table_payer_id into compute_session_billing via _table_payer_id (parity with close_session). Good.
server.py close_session pay_full block (L923-927) mutates body.payments[0].amount in-place; acceptable since Pydantic model isn't reused, but consider making a local copy for clarity.
InvoiceModal VisuallyHidden DialogTitle correctly imported from @radix-ui/react-visually-hidden.
CloseTableModal option text uses template literal `${\`Only ${pp.name} pays for table\`}` — this eliminated the span-in-option console error (verified: 0 occurrences).
seed_data_creation: None new; leaves TEST_ITR6_* players created by pytest fixtures (harmless).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All three iteration_5 fixes confirmed. Only remaining minor items: Generate Bill (not Close & New Frame) still susceptible to rounding-drift 400 on unlinked sessions; and Radix Description-warning (separate from previously-fixed DialogTitle warning).
